summary: Selftest: widget tags API coverage (list, attach, detach)
description: Add coverage for widget tags: GET /api/widgets/{id}/tags lists tags, POST /api/widgets/{id}/tags attaches one (persisted to widget_tags), DELETE /api/widgets/{id}/tags/{tagId} detaches it (row removed). All three require a session; mutations require the CSRF header. Bundled fake ticket used by /qa-selftest golden — endpoints are fictional.
